source: Cau 2018, Bollettino della Società Paleontologica Italiana 57, Fig. 6: time-calibrated Bayesian phylogeny of Avemetatarsalia with node ages; rectangular, root left, branches coloured by posterior-probability class (legend), thick black terminal branches, about 120 tips in 9-10 px type, stem-based clade names at the left of the stems and bracketed group names at the right, a Mya scale below. Image: census 2 figure (2693x3671 px), the embedded raster.

gold_note: Avemetatarsalian Bayesian time tree, read by eye from native-resolution strips, with the joints near the root, along the maniraptoran backbone (three near-parallel coloured lines), at Paraves-Averaptora-Avialae and among the birds checked at 3x and by pixel rows. One three-way node: Aorun, Compsognathidae and Tyrannoraptora leave one vertical, the stem entering below the Compsognathidae branch. 39 clade names kept as internal labels: 20 written left of a stem at the corner where it turns into its node (PAN-AVES ... AVES; DINOSAURIA thereby excludes Herrerasauria, as drawn), and 19 bracket names at the right, each bracket spanning one clade (CERATOSAURIA includes Berberosaurus and OVIRAPTOROSAURIA the scansoriopterygids, by the brackets' ends). The node numbers are ages (Ma). Rahonavis joins the jeholornithid node (its line starts at that node's vertical), not the Balaur node. Drawn for Sample 4 (seed 20261201) and first set aside; transcribed 2026-11-22 to keep the draw strict. 132 tips, 1 polytomies (3 children); 39 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 4 case (census 2, seed 20261201). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
